$comment: Every Hexactra capability and where it lives on each surface. A surface is a value or a list of values (REST operations as 'METHOD /api/path', a CLI command path, an MCP tool name, a TUI screen route, a web route) or {"none": "why"}. Tests on each surface fail when a value is missing there: apps/api/test/capabilities.db.spec.ts (REST, MCP), apps/cli/src/capabilities.test.ts (CLI, TUI), apps/web/src/__tests__/capabilities.test.ts (web). Every app REST operation and every MCP tool must belong to a capability.

restExempt.GET /api/fleet/desktop-auth: nginx's auth_request for a host's remote desktop WebSocket, not a client operation
restExempt.POST /api/notification-actions: the notification buttons' token-authenticated channel from the service worker; on every surface the same actions are runs.cancel and inbox.answer
restExempt.POST /api/questions/{id}/answer-by-token: the webhook channel's single-use token answer for a receiver with no session; on every surface the same action is questions.answer
